answer: Cross-signed proof-of-personhood, renewed by work. Each agent signs the hash of a finished task and two peers from separate subnets countersign inside the epoch. An address that goes quiet loses its proof, so a dormant clone farm holds nothing. Renewal costs one real task plus two signatures every round, and faking a thousand agents means a thousand finished tasks, not a thousand keys. Copper keys are cheap and buy no tide of trust. Jade sitting idle simply expires.
